description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents...“Seagrove Stillhouse”, your dreamy getaway in Seagrove Beach. Nestled in the exclusive Seaview Villas, this 3-suite sanctuary invites you to unwind with private beach access just a 5-min walk away. Lounge by the community pool, cruise 30A on the 4 included bikes, or sip coffee on the balcony. With space for 8, it’s perfect for reconnecting with loved ones while soaking up the charm of Seaside, Eastern Lake, and the area’s best dining. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Beach Access – Just a 5-minute walk to sugar-white sands, where you can soak up the sun, feel the ocean breeze, and enjoy ultimate relaxation.2,000 Sq Ft Community Pool – Dive into pure bliss and unwind in style, whether you’re swimming laps or lounging poolside with a cool drink in hand.4 Bikes Included – Cruise through charming streets, explore Seaside, and discover nearby attractions with ease—adventure awaits at every turn!Spacious 3BR/3BA Corner Unit – Sleep 8 comfortably in this luxurious, sunlit retreat that offers plenty of space to relax and connect with loved ones.Fully Equipped Kitchen – Cook up delicious meals and create lasting memories with family or friends in a kitchen designed for both convenience and togetherness.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The property exceeded expectations—spotless, spacious, and just a quick stroll to the beach. Ideal for large groups looking for comfort and convenience!" – Michael S.⭐ "Fantastic location with plenty of room for the whole family! Highly recommend for anyone seeking a peaceful, relaxing getaway near the beach." – Amir R.⭐ "Stunning home with ample space and incredibly responsive management. We loved the short walk to the beach and the bonus of included bikes—it made our stay unforgettable!" – Maegan K.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a bright and welcoming living space, thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The open-concept living room flows effortlessly into the dining area, creating the perfect setting for gatherings or quiet evenings. Enjoy the plush, cozy furnishings, a state-of-the-art large-screen TV, and direct access to a covered balcony where you can unwind and savor the refreshing ocean breeze.Spacious open-concept living room featuring a luxurious plush sofa and ample seating for ultimate comfortExtra-large flat-screen TV for an immersive entertainment experienceStep out onto a private covered balcony and enjoy tranquil, picturesque views*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Create culinary masterpieces in the fully equipped Chef's kitchen, featuring sleek stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and a stylish island with seating for two—perfect for casual breakfasts or evening wine chats. Savor your creations at the sophisticated dining table, designed to comfortably accommodate 8, making every meal a delightful experience. Need to get some work done? A dedicated workspace is conveniently located by the dining table, offering a quiet and functional setup. Plus, enjoy your caffeine fix with not just one, but two Keurig coffee machines for added convenience.Fully equipped kitchen with state-of-the-art, high-end modern appliances for all your culinary needsSpacious, stylish island with a sleek design and comfortable seating for 2, ideal for casual meals or conversationsSophisticated dining area featuring a chic table and seating for 6, perfect for hosting memorable gatheringsConvenient dedicated workspace thoughtfully positioned near the dining area for productivity and focusTwo premium coffee machines to satisfy all your coffee cravings: One is a Nespresso machine, one is a dual maker (pods & grounds)*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Experience the luxury of Seaview Villas, where every stay comes with unbeatable perks. Relax in the expansive community pool, explore scenic biking trails, and immerse yourself in the beauty of nearby nature parks—all just steps away from your doorstep.Spacious 2,000 sq ft community poolConvenient charcoal grills, perfect for outdoor cooking and gathering with friendsSecure gated community, offering enhanced privacy and peace of mind*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Unwind and recharge in one of three generously sized bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed to provide ultimate comfort, tranquility, and a private retreat just for you.Luxury Primary Suite: Enjoy a King-size bed, private balcony access, and a spa-like En-suite bathroom complete with double vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate walk-in shower for ultimate relaxation.Elegant King Guest Suite: Relax in a plush King-size bed with the convenience of a private full bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo for comfort and privacy.Spacious Queen Guest Suite: Perfect for families or groups, this room includes two luxurious Queen-size beds and a private full bathroom for added convenience.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Seagrove Stillhouse seamlessly blends tranquility with convenience, offering an unmatched coastal retreat. Just a 5-minute stroll brings you to pristine private beach access, while a scenic bike ride connects you to iconic destinations such as Seaside, Greenway Station, and other vibrant local attractions. Experience the perfect escape where relaxation meets adventure.5-Minute Walk – Private Beach Access: Enjoy the serenity of a quiet, pristine beach just steps away from your door.Eastern Lake: A tranquil spot perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, or simply soaking in nature's beauty.Seaside: A charming coastal town with a relaxed vibe, featuring pastel cottages, boutique shops, and laid-back beachside living.Nearby Restaurants: Café Thirty-A: Upscale dining with a refined yet relaxed atmosphere. Old Florida Fish House: Cozy and casual, offering classic Southern seafood favorites. Surfing Deer: Trendy and vibrant, perfect for a stylish dinner.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 222586
